11:- [GitHub Checks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
github-checks.md): Run an eval suite against the MCP server built from every pull request, and read the result as a check run, a p
ull-request comment, and a machine-readable JSON block.\n24:- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test
cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.\n41:
- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with l
ocal results and an MCPJam identity\n52:- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites,
and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI environments\n71:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-su
ite.md): API reference for EvalSuite\n73:- [runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference
for running an MCPJam suite file locally from code\n88:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-r
uns/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches ex
ecution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-ru
ns/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…\n91:- [Compare a run against a baseline](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md): Compare this run against a baseline run: per-case status (
`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer pass-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, a
nd whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare against the nearest earlier **completed**…\n96:- [Preview a
failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /projects/{projec
tId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform selects every cas
e with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` count trials;
`selectedCase…\n97:- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-failed-cases.md):
Replay a finished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and
passed (cancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases — see the rerun preview. The new run records `
rerunOfRunId` and `rerunScope`, and beca…\n98:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suite
s-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n99:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion fi
rst: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value),
overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n101:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1
`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n102:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an e
nvironment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite m
eans that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n104:- [Crea
te an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-doe
s-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOU
T executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n105:
- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-
suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)
` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body
is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n106:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config,
judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n107:- [Delete an e
val suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs ar
e not deleted.\n108:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-sett
ings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `n
ull` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with th
e full updated suite.\n109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/
get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it call
s and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the

s](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-firs
